long_biography.plain_text:
Schultz turned her Silicon Valley home into a practical base for Washington State University students pursuing technology internships. Over many years, she welcomed hundreds of Frank Engineering Entrepreneurship Institute fellows and provided personalized mentoring and logistical help. She also hosted receptions that introduced interns to alumni working across the Bay Area’s technology community.

Her involvement extended beyond hospitality. By helping students navigate placements and build professional networks, Schultz supported a program that later achieved national recognition. Washington State University Foundation honored Cindy and Gaymond Schultz with its Outstanding Service Award in 2006. In 2014, the alumni association named her an Honorary Alumna, citing her sustained encouragement of Frank Fellows and her role as an ambassador for the university.
